content: @clack/prompts (npm registry verified v1.7.0, 13.8M weekly downloads) is a lightweight (~2-4KB) prompt library with an opinionated, polished terminal UI out of the box (connector lines, spinners, cancel handling) and no theming/plugin layer. Popular for scaffolding tools (create-* CLIs). Good fit when a distinctive sober visual identity matters and prompt types needed are simple (select, multiselect, text, confirm).
